fusions.name: Couched Charge
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles to an enemy with a spike couched low, dealing 14 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rear and Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks out with spurred hooves, dealing 7 damage to everything within 3 tiles in a cone ahead of you. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Barded in Thorns
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Rhythm
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
